items.title: Injectivity and K-injectivity survive restriction of abelian sheaves from the big etale site to a small one, but fail for modules
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file etale-cohomology.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma records that injective and K-injective abelian sheaves on the big etale site stay injective, respectively K-injective, when restricted to the small etale site or pulled back along an object, and that the corresponding statements for modules fail (statement lines 21101-21120). The positive parts (proof lines 21122-21149) are formal from right adjointness of exact functors, with two independent proofs for the pullback case; the negative part (proof lines 21151-21169) is an explicit counterexample over Spec(Z): multiplication by 2 is injective but its pullback is not, and the absence of the dotted arrow exhibits a non-injective restriction of an injective module. H2: formal adjunction arguments plus one explicit counterexample.
